name: Team Squirtle: Sevii Tides Vanguard
archetype: Sevii archipelago traversal — Water/Flying aerial anchor, Electric/Ground speed sweeping, Ice fortress coverage, Intimidate Fighting wallbreaking, and Levitate Ground immunity.
gym_duel_rationale: No gym battle in Chapter 18. All six party members train and travel together in full 6-member route configuration, exploring Knot Island, Treasure Beach, Kindle Road, and Mt. Ember under the Level 72 cap.

roster.progression_notes: 486 BST starter hybrid elevated to Cap 72. STAB Hydro Pump douses Mt. Ember's volcanic Fire and Rock spawns. Drill Peck cleanly dispatches Fighting and Bug threats. Roost provides infinite overworld recovery.
486 BST speed sweeper. STAB Discharge dominates ocean water encounters (Tentacruel, Gyarados). STAB Earthquake annihilates Mt. Ember's Fire and Poison foes.
535 BST Water/Ice fortress elevated to Lv. 71. Dual STAB Ice Beam and Hydro Pump provide devastating coverage. Water Absorb completely negates opposing water attacks while surfing.
479 BST Intimidate bruiser. Blunts enemy physical Attack on entry. Glare paralyzes fast threats with 100% accuracy. STAB Close Combat destroys Normal and Rock opponents.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Immune to Earthquake and Magnitude via Levitate. STAB Psychic eliminates Kindle Road's Fighting trainers effortlessly.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Thick Fat halves incoming Fire attacks on Mt. Ember. RestTalk loop provides infinite sustain across long island route traversal.

flex_bench.rationale: High-durability Grass/Poison tank packing Leech Seed and Sleep Powder for status control against wild encounters.
Intimidate physical pivot and Dragon Dance sweeper with Aqua Tail for Water STAB coverage.
Technician-boosted Triple Kick and Rapid Spin for tactical versatility across route encounters.
